_original_lore: The Bambuleaf Panda is a passive mob that can be found on Galatea.
They only appear while it is Spring or Summer.
name: 竹叶熊猫 (动物)

source: The Bambuleaf Panda is a passive mob that can be found on Galatea.
loreParagraphs.translation: 竹叶熊猫是一种被动生物,可在加拉蒂亚找到.

source: They only appear while it is Spring or Summer.
loreParagraphs.translation: 它们仅在春季或夏季出现.
